title: qnop — Overview
description: Health and activity of a qnop deployment. Series from the database are aggregated with max, per-instance series with sum (docs/OBSERVABILITY.md).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The running version and edition. Two values during a rolling upgrade.

panels.title: Oldest due job
panels.description: How long the longest-waiting due job has waited. A short queue with an old job is a stuck queue.

panels.title: Audit chain
panels.description: 1 when the last audit-chain verification passed, 0 when it found a break. Empty until one has run.

panels.title: Audit breaks
panels.description: Breaks the last audit-chain verification found. Empty until one has run.

panels.title: Slowest endpoints (p95, top 10)
panels.description: The uri is the route template, never a concrete path.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: From the database, so the same on every instance: aggregated with max.

panels.title: Stale jobs reaped
panels.description: Jobs whose worker died mid-run and that were put back in the queue.

panels.title: Extractions by outcome
panels.description: rejected: the upload cannot be read. error: the pipeline failed.

panels.title: Converter slots
panels.description: Per instance and summed: each instance has its own converter slots.

panels.title: Re-anchored annotations
panels.description: What happened to annotations when a new version was uploaded. A rising share of orphaned means anchors are being lost.

panels.title: Review activity
panels.description: Committed review events per interval.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: pending: self-registered and waiting for the e-mail address to be confirmed.

panels.title: Listener failures and dropped events
panels.description: An add-on's event listener threw, or was too slow and the dispatch queue filled up. Flat in a deployment without add-ons.

panels.title: Refresh rotations
panels.description: reused: an already-rotated token was presented again, the shape of a stolen cookie.

panels.title: Mail by outcome
panels.description: skipped: no SMTP server is configured.

panels.title: Stored objects
panels.description: pending: uploaded but not yet committed. A pending count that only grows means the reaper is not running.

panels.title: Time since last run
panels.description: Empty for a job that has never run.

panels.title: Enabled
panels.description: 0 for a job an operator switched off; such a job is not expected to run.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job) (rate(qnop_scheduler_run_seconds_bucket{application="qnop", instance=~"$instance", dry_run="false"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Forwards by outcome
panels.description: Empty when usage tracking is not configured. rejected: the backend answered with an error. error: it could not be reached.

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Seconds spent in garbage-collection pauses per second.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: pending above zero for long means requests are waiting for a connection.
